```{r import}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(broom)
library(parameters)
library(knitr)  
library(interactions)
path <- "/Users/mlin2/Desktop/RabLab/tasks/concurrent/cleaned_dat/" 
mergedat <- read_csv(paste0(path, "merged_baseline_wDemo.csv"))
mergedat$log_ptau217 <- log(mergedat$ptau217)
mergedat <- mergedat %>% 
  filter(
    !is.na(ptau217),
    !is.na(desikan_suvr),
    !is.na(centiloid_wcbl)
  )
df_base_eoad <- mergedat %>% filter(dx == "EOAD") 
df_base_ci <- mergedat %>% filter(dx == "EOAD" | dx =="EOnonAD")
covars <- c("age_at_ptau", "sex", "years_education")

# total length by dx
by_dx <- df_base_ci %>% count(dx)
print(by_dx)
```

```{r helper function for reporting}
extract_term_stats <- function(fit, term_name) {
  raw_tbl <- broom::tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(.data$term == term_name)

  std_tbl <- parameters::standardize_parameters(fit, method = "posthoc") %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    rename(term = Parameter) %>%
    filter(.data$term == term_name)

  if (nrow(raw_tbl) == 0 || nrow(std_tbl) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      b = NA_real_, b_low = NA_real_, b_high = NA_real_, p = NA_real_,
      beta = NA_real_, beta_low = NA_real_, beta_high = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  tibble(
    b = raw_tbl$estimate,
    b_low = raw_tbl$conf.low,
    b_high = raw_tbl$conf.high,
    p = raw_tbl$p.value,
    beta = std_tbl$Std_Coefficient,
    beta_low = std_tbl$CI_low,
    beta_high = std_tbl$CI_high
  )
}

summarize_model_row <- function(fit, model_name, term_map) {
  out <- tibble(
    model = model_name,
    formula = paste(deparse(formula(fit)), collapse = ""),
    n = nobs(fit),
    r2 = summary(fit)$r.squared,
    adj_r2 = summary(fit)$adj.r.squared
  )

  for (term_name in names(term_map)) {
    prefix <- term_map[[term_name]]
    stats <- extract_term_stats(fit, term_name)

    out[[paste0(prefix, "_b")]]        <- stats$b
    out[[paste0(prefix, "_b_low")]]    <- stats$b_low
    out[[paste0(prefix, "_b_high")]]   <- stats$b_high
    out[[paste0(prefix, "_p")]]        <- stats$p
    out[[paste0(prefix, "_beta")]]     <- stats$beta
    out[[paste0(prefix, "_beta_low")]] <- stats$beta_low
    out[[paste0(prefix, "_beta_high")]]<- stats$beta_high
  }

  out
}

make_formula <- function(outcome, rhs, covars = character(0)) {
  f <- paste(outcome, "~", rhs)
  if (length(covars) > 0) {
    f <- paste0(f, " + ", paste(covars, collapse = " + "))
  }
  as.formula(f)
}

fit_model_block <- function(df, cohort_name, outcome, covars = character(0)) {
  needed <- unique(c(outcome, "centiloid_wcbl", "desikan_suvr", covars))
  miss <- setdiff(needed, names(df))
  if (length(miss) > 0) stop("Missing columns in ", cohort_name, ": ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))

  dd <- df %>% drop_na(all_of(needed))

  m1_cl     <- lm(make_formula(outcome, "centiloid_wcbl", covars), data = dd)
  m2_tau    <- lm(make_formula(outcome, "desikan_suvr", covars), data = dd)
  m3_cl_tau <- lm(make_formula(outcome, "centiloid_wcbl + desikan_suvr", covars), data = dd)
  m4_inter  <- lm(make_formula(outcome, "centiloid_wcbl * desikan_suvr", covars), data = dd)

  term_map <- c(
    centiloid_wcbl = "CL",
    desikan_suvr = "TAU",
    `centiloid_wcbl:desikan_suvr` = "CLxTAU"
  )

  bind_rows(
    summarize_model_row(m1_cl,     "pTau ~ CL",       term_map),
    summarize_model_row(m2_tau,    "pTau ~ TAU",      term_map),
    summarize_model_row(m3_cl_tau, "pTau ~ CL + TAU",  term_map),
    summarize_model_row(m4_inter,  "pTau ~ CL * TAU",  term_map)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      cohort = cohort_name,
      outcome = outcome,
      adjusted = if_else(length(covars) > 0, "adjusted", "unadjusted"),
      covariates = if_else(length(covars) > 0,
                           paste(covars, collapse = " + "),
                           "none")
    ) %>%
    select(cohort, outcome, adjusted, covariates, everything())
}
```


```{r all combinations for ptau ~ pet}
# combinations - outcome is ptau or log ptau, covariates none or all 
all_results <- bind_rows(
  fit_model_block(df_base_ci,   "df_base_ci",   "log_ptau217", character(0)),
  fit_model_block(df_base_ci,   "df_base_ci",   "log_ptau217", covars),
  fit_model_block(df_base_ci,   "df_base_ci",   "ptau217",     character(0)),
  fit_model_block(df_base_ci,   "df_base_ci",   "ptau217",     covars),

  fit_model_block(df_base_eoad, "df_base_eoad", "log_ptau217", character(0)),
  fit_model_block(df_base_eoad, "df_base_eoad", "log_ptau217", covars),
  fit_model_block(df_base_eoad, "df_base_eoad", "ptau217",     character(0)),
  fit_model_block(df_base_eoad, "df_base_eoad", "ptau217",     covars)
)

all_results_round <- all_results %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
all_results_round
```


```{r compact result table}
fmt_term <- function(b, low, high, p, digits = 3) {
  if (any(is.na(c(b, low, high, p)))) return(NA_character_)
  sprintf(
    paste0("%.", digits, "f [%.", digits, "f, %.", digits, "f], p=%.", digits, "f"),
    b, low, high, p
  )
}

result_vis <- all_results_round %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    model = paste0(
      cohort, " | ",
      case_when( #shorten model name
        model == "pTau ~ CL" ~ "CL",
        model == "pTau ~ TAU" ~ "TAU",
        model == "pTau ~ CL + TAU" ~ "CL + TAU",
        model == "pTau ~ CL * TAU" ~ "CL * TAU",
        TRUE ~ model
      ),
      " | ",
      if_else(outcome == "log_ptau217", "log(ptau)", "ptau"), #rename outcome
      if_else(adjusted == "adjusted", " +covar", "") #shorten cov
    ),
    `CL` = fmt_term(CL_b, CL_b_low, CL_b_high, CL_p),
    `TAU` = fmt_term(TAU_b, TAU_b_low, TAU_b_high, TAU_p),
    `Interaction` = fmt_term(CLxTAU_b, CLxTAU_b_low, CLxTAU_b_high, CLxTAU_p),
    `Significant covariates` = NA_character_,
    `Adjusted R^2` = adj_r2
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(model, `CL`, `TAU`, `Interaction`, `Significant covariates`, `Adjusted R^2`)

# get covar p  
get_covar_pvals <- function(df, cohort_name, outcome, covars) {
  
  needed <- unique(c(outcome, "centiloid_wcbl", "desikan_suvr", covars))
  dd <- df %>% drop_na(all_of(needed))
  
  fits <- list(
    "CL"      = lm(make_formula(outcome, "centiloid_wcbl", covars), data = dd),
    "TAU"     = lm(make_formula(outcome, "desikan_suvr", covars), data = dd),
    "CL+TAU"  = lm(make_formula(outcome, "centiloid_wcbl + desikan_suvr", covars), data = dd),
    "CL*TAU"  = lm(make_formula(outcome, "centiloid_wcbl * desikan_suvr", covars), data = dd)
  )
  
  bind_rows(lapply(names(fits), function(mname) {
    broom::tidy(fits[[mname]]) %>%
      filter(term %in% covars) %>%
      transmute(
        cohort = cohort_name,
        outcome = outcome,
        model = mname,
        term = term,
        estimate = estimate,
        p_value = p.value
      )
  }))
}

covar_pvals <- bind_rows(
  get_covar_pvals(df_base_ci,   "df_base_ci",   "log_ptau217", covars),
  get_covar_pvals(df_base_ci,   "df_base_ci",   "ptau217",     covars),
  get_covar_pvals(df_base_eoad, "df_base_eoad", "log_ptau217", covars),
  get_covar_pvals(df_base_eoad, "df_base_eoad", "ptau217",     covars)
) %>%
  mutate(p_value = round(p_value, 4),
         estimate = round(estimate, 3))
 

# Collapse significant covariates
sig_covars <- covar_pvals %>%
  filter(p_value < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(term, " (p=", sprintf("%.3f", p_value), ")")
  ) %>%
  group_by(cohort, outcome, model) %>%
  summarise(
    sig_covars = paste(label, collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# model keys
result_vis <- result_vis %>%
  mutate(
    model_key = case_when(
      grepl("CL \\* TAU", model) ~ "CL*TAU",
      grepl("CL \\+ TAU", model) ~ "CL+TAU",
      grepl("\\| CL \\|", model) ~ "CL",
      grepl("\\| TAU \\|", model) ~ "TAU",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# add covariates
result_vis <- result_vis %>%
  left_join(
    sig_covars,
    by = c("cohort", "outcome", "model_key" = "model")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    `Significant covariates` = sig_covars
  ) %>%
  select(-sig_covars, -model_key)

# disp
knitr::kable(result_vis, align = "lccccr")

# save to csv 
readr::write_csv(
  result_vis,
  file = paste0(path, "ptau_pet_model_summary_with_covars.csv")
)
```

```{r interaction plot ~ tau}
 
p_ci <- interact_plot(
  fit_ci,
  pred = desikan_suvr,
  modx = centiloid_wcbl,
  modx.values = "terciles",
  modx.labels = c("Low CL", "Mid CL", "High CL"),   
  plot.points = TRUE,
  interval = TRUE
) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "#fcae70", high = "#cb181d") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#fcae70", high = "#cb181d") +
  labs(
    title = "CI (EOAD + EOnonAD)",
    x = "Tau PET (desikan_suvr)",
    y = "Predicted log(pTau)",
    color = "CL tertiles",
    fill = "CL tertiles"
  ) + theme_classic()

# FORCE y-axis
p_ci$scales$scales <- p_ci$scales$scales[
  !sapply(p_ci$scales$scales, function(s) "y" %in% s$aesthetics)
]
p_ci <- p_ci + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-3, 3))

p_eoad <- interact_plot(
  fit_eoad,
  pred = desikan_suvr,
  modx = centiloid_wcbl,
  modx.values = "terciles",
  modx.labels = c("Low CL", "Mid CL", "High CL"), 
  plot.points = TRUE,
  interval = TRUE
) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "#fcae91", high = "#cb181d") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#fcae91", high = "#cb181d") +
  labs(
    title = "EOAD only",
    x = "Tau PET (desikan_suvr)",
    y = "Predicted log(pTau)",
    color = "CL tertiles",
    fill = "CL tertiles"
  )+ theme_classic()

# FORCE y-axis
p_eoad$scales$scales <- p_eoad$scales$scales[
  !sapply(p_eoad$scales$scales, function(s) "y" %in% s$aesthetics)
]
p_eoad <- p_eoad + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-3, 3))
```
